question: If p and q are the roots of x² + 4x − 21 = 0 and p then the quadratic equation in x whose roots are (p − 1) and (q + 1) is:
solution:
**Given:**

x² + 4x − 21 = 0

**Calculation:**

x² + 4x − 21 = 0

⇒ x² + 7x - 3x − 21 = 0

⇒ x(x + 7) - 3(x +7) = 0

⇒ (x +7)(x - 3) = 0

⇒ x = 3, -7

Roots are p and q, so q = 3 and p = -7, as p 

(p − 1) and (q + 1) = (-7 -1) and (3 + 1) = -8 and 4.

So equation can written as:

⇒ (x +4)(x - 8) = 0

⇒ x² + 4x − 32 = 0

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
